scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; C++ and GLSL sources read, the embedded SPIR-V word arrays (debug_probe_spirv.h, about 80 lines of hex) not disassembled; test files skimmed
findings: Adds two opt-in debug switches: LEONIDA_PROBE (replaces matching pipelines' vertex/pixel stages with built-in solid-green shaders; extra MODE and POS env options) and LEONIDA_DEBUG_CLEAR (all-zero RT clears become magenta). Off unless env vars set; env parsing uses getenv_s/_dupenv_s with bounds and range checks.

Risky-but-opt-in note: precompiled SPIR-V is checked in as hex arrays; the PR also adds the .vert/.frag sources and a 95-line Python test that seems intended to keep them in sync, but I did not rebuild or verify it. Tripwire hit is a normal D3D call in a test. No overlaps, applies cleanly.
